title: L9 post-publish repository handoff (l9.session_handoff.v1)
description: The comprehensive end-of-contract brief the agent writes to .l9/memory/handoff.json after make pr. The Stop hook memory_writeback.py carries it losslessly inside the ONE continuation record it already writes for the IN-SCOPE repository's namespace. Enforced by ops/memory/session_handoff.py; this schema is its machine form. Also enforced there and not expressible here: the normalized brief is at most 32768 bytes (UTF-8 JSON). Environment, bootstrap and governance friction does not belong here: it goes in .l9/memory/governance-handoff.json (l9.governance_handoff.v1).

pr_number.description: The published PR's number. Must equal the number in .l9/pr/pr-summary.json written by make pr, or the brief is not this publication's and is refused. A number with a zero fractional part (7.0) is the integer 7.

objective.description: What this contract set out to do.

status.description: Where things stand right now, in one or two sentences.

published.description: What shipped in this PR. Empty is []. Absent or null is treated as [].

completed.description: What is done and verified. Empty is []. Absent or null is treated as [].

next_actions.description: The next concrete steps for the next session. Empty is []. Absent or null is treated as [].

risks.description: Known risks introduced or left. Empty is []. Absent or null is treated as [].
